about: Assembling (docs/sandbox/CONSTRUCTS.md, 'Assembling'): what an Assembler builds. Written by tools/constructs/assembling.py: fix it, not this file. 'output' names a part, 'count' how many a batch makes (default 1), 'materials' the bulk materials (Recycling.json) and 'parts' the item parts it takes, 'seconds' the work at speed 1, 'minTier' the lowest tier of Assembler (default 1). At most 6 inputs; a physics-only part can't be an input.
